d:
The Mavericks defeated the Rockets, 116-111 tonight in Dallas. Kyrie Irving contributed a team-high 35 points to go with 9 assists 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds, with Cooper Flagg of the Mavericks adding an additional 33 points (13-19 FG) in the game. Kevin Durant finished with a team-high 28 points along with 5 rebounds for the Rockets in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 4-2 with the win, while the Rockets fall to 5-1 for the season.
